{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# First, check if any revenue values have non-standard formatting
print("Revenue values with non-standard formatting (e.g., extra commas, spaces):")
print(df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9,.]', na=False).sum())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):"," , qa_mask.sum())

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Filter out QA and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Now compute average revenue per order in the campaign
avg_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output result
print(f"Average revenue per order (after removing QA and refunded orders): {avg_revenue}")

# Return values for reporting
avg_revenue"}}
